game.name: Samurai Warriors 2 : Empires (USA)
game.desc: Samurai Warriors 2: Empires is both a beat 'em all and a strategy game for Xbox 360. Lead your warrior leader and troops in Empire mode, which features a plethora of historical campaigns such as the Honnôji Incident and the Battle of Kawanakajima. An editor allows you to create your own custom hero for use in other game modes.
